select v.video_id, v.grade, v.video_name, s.subject_name, t.test_name, v.create_time from ms_video v,ms_subjects s,ms_test t where v.del_flag='0' and v.subject_id=s.subject_id and v.test_id=t.test_id
and v.grade=#{grade}

select v.grade, v.video_name, s.subject_name, t.test_name, v.video_url, v.cover_url from ms_video v,ms_subjects s,ms_test t where v.del_flag='0' and v.subject_id=s.subject_id and v.test_id=t.test_id and v.video_id=#{videoId};
